messages:
mike.support: Escalating a priority handoff for Brightwell Labs — trial customer. Two issues: SSO failing with SAML assertion error and embeddings provisioning stuck at 'queued'. Renewal/auto-convert date in 12 days. Need CS to take point on comms + enablement and decide whether to offer temporary concession.
asha.support: Repro + ticket 4472 created. Error from IdP: AssertionConsumerService mismatch. We've tried re-uploading metadata and SAML debug shows mismatch on ACS URL.
darren-csm: @elena.cs tagging you — high renewal risk if we don't move fast. Any bandwidth for a quick CS-led troubleshooting + enablement?
elena.cs: I can take this. Quick plan: 1) immediate handoff call with Brightwell + Support triage 2) provisional quota bump to unblock eval 3) schedule enablement session to complete SSO setup and best-practice embed tuning 4) follow-up check at renewal. Who owns the quota bump/exec approval?
mike.support: ops-bot picked up a quota bump request but needs CS approval and manager signoff. Also note customer's logs show repeated 401s after SAML assertion.
ops-bot: Quota bump request submitted as RB-834. Current status: pending-cs-approval. ETA for applied change if approved: ~25 minutes.
asha.support: Quick note on embeddings: provisioning stuck due to missing manifest.s3 URI — support triggered a re-ingest but it failed with 503 from storage. Ops investigating.
elena.cs: Okay — immediate next steps from CS side: A) I'll join the troubleshooting call with Support and Brightwell at 16:00 PT B) I'll draft a short comms template to AM and exec sponsor offering a 2-week evaluation extension + 10% credit if onboarding completes before renewal C) I'll own the enablement session (30m) on SSO/embeds.
darren-csm: Sounds good. Please include me on the comms and cc AM (sara@brightwell). I can do escalation to sales leadership if needed.
mike.support: Meeting invite sent to Brightwell + support + elena/darren for 16:00 PT — invite includes link to logs and ticket 4472.
elena.cs: Draft of comms I will send after meeting: "Hi Sara — we're escalating to resolve SSO and provisioning, assigning a CS lead (Elena) and a support engineer to fast-track. Proposed remediation: immediate config check, temporary quota bump, and a 30m enablement call. If we resolve prior to renewal we'll extend trial. Can you confirm availability for 16:00 PT?" Thoughts?
a sha.support: small typo in the draft: 'availability for 16:00 PT' is fine. Also recommend adding the temporary access workaround: `use API key X for embed calls until SSO resolved` (but redact actual key in comms).
elena.cs: Good call — will phrase as 'temporary API-key-based access for ingestion' and not include key. Action items: elena = own comms + enablement; darren = escalation to AM/sales; mike = ensure support triage + logs; asha = follow storage ops; ops-bot = apply quota on cs-approval.
ops-bot: RB-834 updated to status 'awaiting-cs-approval'. To approve, reply 'approve RB-834' in thread.
elena.cs: Approve RB-834. Approve RB-834.
ops-bot: RB-834 status: 'approved' — quota bump applied.
asha.support: Storage team reports transient S3 503 resolved; re-ingest triggered and embedding provisioning resumed.
mike.support: Quick patch deployed to SSO helper to accept alternate ACS hostnames (rollback-safe). Deploy log: `deploy 2022-11-23T15:40Z helper#patch-ssocheck` — seemed to stop assertion mismatch for a test user.
elena.cs: Great. I'll run the 30m enablement at 17:00 PT and confirm the SSO steps with their IdP engineer. Post-enablement we'll circulate a short success note and the extended trial terms.
darren-csm: If enablement completes, I'll queue the renewal to 'healthy' in CRM and remove immediate churn flag.
mike.support: Closing loop: ticket 4472 updated with remediation steps and notes. I'll handoff to elena for ongoing CS comms.
elena.cs: Thanks team. I'll post the after-action summary here after the enablement with next steps for renewal and any follow-ups for product.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: post-enablement summary due in 24h
